method: Extend the five-state edge-survival design with a same-successor/different-predecessor control to distinguish genuine predecessor-specific dependence from generic successor gating.
basis: Continues SCAN-022, which separates freshness confounding from predecessor-specific temporal dependence.

connections.name: SAME_SUCCESSOR_DIFFERENT_PREDECESSOR_CONTROL
connections.observation: If the same successor B remains admissible after replacing predecessor A with structurally matched predecessor C, then the evidence for A-specific dependence is weakened.
connections.claim_ceiling: This is a discriminating control, not evidence that the predecessor is causally irrelevant.

connections.name: PREDECESSOR_SPECIFICITY_REQUIRES_ASYMMETRY
connections.observation: A strong predecessor-specific edge should show directional asymmetry: the real predecessor preserves the successor relation, while matched alternative predecessors do not, after freshness is held constant.

connections.name: SUCCESSOR_GATE_VS_PREDECESSOR_EDGE
connections.observation: A generic gate may reject many altered predecessors equally. A predecessor-specific relation should reject the wrong predecessor more strongly than unrelated matched alternatives.
connections.test: Compare effect size for true-edge rewiring against a matched alternative-predecessor substitution.

connections.name: RELATION_SPECIFICITY_IS_DIRECTIONAL
connections.observation: Temporal recurrence alone is not enough: A->B and B->A must be treated as distinct candidate edges unless the JSON explicitly supports reversibility.
connections.negative_control: Do not symmetrize temporal edges during graph construction.

connections.name: PROVENANCE_LINEAGE_IS_NOT_PREDECESSOR_SPECIFICITY
connections.observation: Repeated version/parent lineage can create a trivial predecessor-successor relation. Such direct lineage must be scored separately from cross-domain operator recurrence.
connections.rule: Lineage-only matches are not eligible for the strongest Connection class without an additional relation-specific control.

edge_survival_matrix_v3.strong_interpretation: A candidate is substantially stronger when it survives semantic/provenance blinding and freshness-only manipulation, but collapses when the specific predecessor relation is rewired or replaced by a matched alternative predecessor.

execution_requirements: Freeze extraction rule before inspecting outcomes.
Match predecessor and alternative-predecessor on schema and relevant marginal structure.
Preserve external freshness-equivalent state across temporal rewiring and alternative-predecessor substitutions.
Do not use prior Connection labels as features during scoring.
Report continuous effect sizes and null distributions, not only binary present/absent outcomes.
Keep direct parent-child/version lineage separate from cross-domain relational candidates.
important_negative_control: If REAL, REWIRED, and ALTERNATIVE_PREDECESSOR all remain positive, the apparent temporal connection is better interpreted as a generic successor gate rather than a specific predecessor edge.
epistemic_boundary: No causal or physical claim is promoted by this scan. It defines a stronger falsification-oriented test for data-level temporal connections.
next_gate: Run the six-state matched permutation benchmark on concrete JSON pairs and estimate predecessor-specific effect size versus freshness-only and schema-matched null controls.
